de: 高雄治水 李鸿源直言缺乏执行机制. 豪雨重创南台湾，高雄治水议题引发蓝绿交锋。 Kuomintang Kaohsiungs Bürgermeisterkandidat Ke Zhien lud am 26. den ehemaligen Innenminister Li Hongyuan ein, die Lage zu überprüfen. Li Hongyuan sagte, dass „Geld kein Problem“ bei der Wasserkontrolle in Kaohsiung sei. Der Schlüssel liegt darin, ob die wahre Ursache der Überschwemmung gefunden wird, ob das Geld dort ausgegeben wird, wo es ausgegeben werden sollte, und wer die Folgemaßnahmen durchführt Implementierung.
title: 高雄治水 李鴻源直言缺乏執行機制
description: 豪雨重創南台灣，高雄治水議題引發藍綠交鋒。國民黨高雄市長參選人柯志恩26日邀前內政部長李鴻源實勘把脈，李鴻源表示，高雄治水「錢不是問題」，關鍵在於有沒有找到淹水的真正原因、錢有沒有花在該花的地方，以及後續由誰來執行。民進黨高雄市長參選人賴瑞隆則強調，治水不分黨派且持續累進，已力爭中央資源補強。
en: Kaohsiung water control Li Hongyuan bluntly stated that there is a lack of enforcement mechanism. Heavy rains hit southern Taiwan hard, and the Kaohsiung water control issue triggered a confrontation between blue and green. Kuomintang Kaohsiung mayoral candidate Ke Zhien invited former Interior Minister Li Hongyuan to check the situation on the 26th. Li Hongyuan said that "money is not an issue" in Kaohsiung's water control. The key lies in whether the real cause of the flooding is found, whether the money is spent where it should be spent, and who will carry out the follow-up implementation. Democratic Progressive Party Kaohsiung mayoral candidate Lai Ruilong emphasized that water management is irrespective of party affiliation and will continue to be progressive, and he has strived to strengthen central resources.
la: Kaohsiung aqua imperium Li Hongyuan obtuse affirmavit defectus mechanismi cogendi. Imbres graves Taiwan meridianas duras feriunt, et Kaohsiung aquae temperantiae exitus conflictationem inter caeruleum et viridem Urguet. Kuomintang Kaohsiung candidatus mayoralis Ke Zhien invitavit priorem Ministrum interiorem Li Hongyuan ad condicionem reprimendam die 26. Li Hongyuan dixit "pecuniam fluxum non esse" in potestate aquae Kaohsiung. Clavis iacet num vera causa inundationis inveniatur, sive pecunia ubi expendatur, et quis exsecutionem exsecutioni mandare voluerit. Democratica Factio Progressiva Kaohsiung candidatus mayoralis Lai Ruilong inculcavit administrationem aquarum sine partium affiliatione et progressivas esse, et medias facultates firmare conatus est.

en: NASA's Roman Space Telescope will be launched at the end of the month, and its large observation field will make up for the shortcomings of Hubble and Webb. IT House reported on August 26 that although we are still a long way from truly understanding the nature of the universe, humankind's understanding of the universe has also reached an unprecedented level. en:
The price of a quick car. In August 2026, Mercedes-Benz and BMW released short videos one after another, pointing to the same question in different ways: is a car drawn or verified? In the Mercedes-Benz short film, a car drives out of the box dragged by the mouse. The text on the screen gets to the point: "What is framed is the car. What is measured is the strength."
Crash cars are not the inevitable cause of Death Valley for new cars, but when actual vehicle verification is replaced by simulation data, necessary tests are deleted, and consumers passively become test drivers, speed changes from competitiveness to the accelerator of Death Valley. BMW China started with a seemingly absurd test scene, then cut into the company's real crash laboratory and wind tunnel facilities, and ended with one sentence: "It is not BMW without hard-core baptism." The spearhead of the two traditional luxury brands, jointly...
la:
Celeri pretium currus. Mense Augusto 2026, Mercedes-Benz et BMW breves videos inter se emittuntur, eandem quaestionem diversimode demonstrant: estne car ducta vel verificata? In Mercedes-Benz cinematographicum breve cinematographicum e mure trahens agit. Textus in tegumentum ad punctum accedit: "Quae gignitur raeda est. Quae mensuratur vis est."

de: Lu Xiuyan von der Hilfswahl in Taitung sagte, dass die Kürzung des Mondkuchenbudgets für benachteiligte Gruppen durch den Gesetzgeber des blauen Lagers „eine Ausübung seiner Macht“ sei. Der Bürgermeister von Taichung, Lu Xiuyan, besuchte heute Taitung und setzte sich im Tianhou-Palast von Taitung für den KMT-Kreisbürgermeisterkandidaten und Sprecher Wu Xiuhua ein. Es war nur eine Angewohnheit, Taichung zu nennen, aber wenn es um Taitung ging, nannte sie „Taichung“, was die Leute verwirrte. Lu Xiuyan half allen am Tatort, „gefrorener Knoblauch (gewählt)“ zu rufen und sagte auch, dass das blaue Lager das höchste Drohnen- und Sozialhilfebudget in der Geschichte verabschiedet habe. „Viele Menschen kamen, um den vom Präsidentenpalast zurückgelassenen Mondkuchen zu helfen. Ich rief alle dazu auf, den Benachteiligten zu helfen, ein fröhliches Mittherbstfest zu feiern.“
title: 盧秀燕台東輔選 稱藍營立委砍弱勢月餅預算是「行使職權」
description: 台中市長盧秀燕今天訪問台東，並在台東天后宮為國民黨縣長參選人、議長吳秀華造勢，只是台中喊習慣，說到台東卻喊頻說成台中，讓人聽得一頭霧水。盧秀燕幫現場所有人喊「凍蒜（當選）」，也稱藍營通過史上最高無人機預算和社福預算，「被總統府棄單的月餅有很多人伸援，呼籲大家一起幫忙弱勢過一個中秋好節」。
en: Lu Xiuyan, Taitung Auxiliary Election, said that the blue camp legislator's cutting of the moon cake budget for disadvantaged groups was an "exercise of power." Taichung Mayor Lu Xiuyan visited Taitung today and campaigned for the Kuomintang county mayor candidate and speaker Wu Xiuhua at the Tianhou Palace in Taitung. Lu Xiuyan helped everyone at the scene shout "frozen garlic (elected)", also saying that the blue camp passed the highest drone budget and social welfare budget in history. "Many people came to help the mooncakes that were abandoned by the presidential palace. I called on everyone to help the disadvantaged celebrate a happy Mid-Autumn Festival."
la: Lu Xiuyan, Taitung Electio auxiliaris dixit legislatoris castra caerulea incisionem massae lunae pro coetibus pauperibus "exercitatio potentiae" fuisse. Taichung Majorem Lu Xiuyan hodie Taitung visitavit et pro Kuomintang comitatu maiore candidato et oratore Wu Xiuhua apud Tianhou Palatium in Taitung militavit. Lu Xiuyan omnes ad scaenam clamant adiuverunt "allium congelatum (electum)", etiam dicens castra caerulea transivisse summam fuci oeconomicam et oeconomiam socialem in historia. "Multi homines venerunt ad auxilium lunae, quae a palatio praesidentiali deserebantur. Omnes invocavi ut subveniret pauperibus, beatum Medio autumni festivitatem cele- brare".

title: 陳淞山觀點》賴清德的「三合一」選戰政治布局
description: [Newtalk新聞] 台灣的選戰在初選或徵召提名時，常有「見樹不見林」的政治觀感，尤其是在縣市與重要鄉鎮市長提名突然冒出許多「名不見經傳」或「不太可能會贏」的人選時，常讓人宛如霧裡看花，摸不著頭緒，外界就很容易陷入黨內派系暗中較勁的政治聯想，總以為就只是政治上權謀算計的政治操作，把被徵召提名的人選罵得一文不值，就好像是註定「穩輸」的政治布局。 殊不知，等到該徵召提名的人選布局最後拼圖完成後，可能就是個綜覽全局的戰法，貫穿地方與中央選戰整體布局的思維考量，原來這些外界認為可能打不贏選戰的「奇兵」，在歷經地方選舉縣…
en: Chen Songshan’s Viewpoint” Lai Ching-te’s “three-in-one” campaign political layout. [Newtalk News] In Taiwan’s election campaigns, there is often a political perception of “missing the forest for the trees” during primaries or nominations. Especially when many “little-known” or “unlikely-to-win” candidates suddenly appear in the nominations for mayors of counties, cities and important towns, it often feels like seeing through the fog. If you don’t have a clue, it’s easy for the outside world to fall into the political association of secret rivalry between factions within the party. They always think that it is just a political maneuver for political intrigue, and scolding the candidates who are recruited and nominated as worthless, as if it is a political layout that is destined to "guaranteed defeat." As everyone knows, when the final jigsaw puzzle of the candidates to be recruited and nominated is completed, it may be an overall strategy that runs through the thinking and considerations of the overall layout of local and central elections. It turns out that these "surprise soldiers" who the outside world thought might not win the election, after going through local elections in counties...

Evenit ut hi "mirum milites" qui extra mundum putaverunt electionem obtinere non possent, postquam electiones locales in comitatu pervadunt.
